items.information: **REGISTRO** A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos: 1. Tomar todos os cuidados referente ao COVID-19 e seguir o que será indicado pelo delegado e organizador da competição; 2. Conhecer as regras da WCA, pois é uma competição oficial; 3. Escolher os eventos a serem registrados com cuidado após revisar as guias Eventos e Cronograma. Preste atenção aos formatos das rodadas e seus cortes/limites; 4. Se inscrever através do site da WCA. A inscrição terá custo de R$ 30,00 (inscrição+camiseta) para os competidores pagos nos dias da competição durante o credenciamento. 5. Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do e-mail (welbertmoutta@hotmail.com), bem como o delegado por meio do e-mail (gsantos@worldcubeassociation.org). O acesso ao local será permitido mediante comprovação de esquema vacinal completo, ou, uma dose de vacina e teste negativo para Covid-19 do tipo PCR, realizado até 48 horas antes do ingresso no local, ou do tipo antígeno, realizado até 24 horas antes do ingresso no estabelecimento (para o competidor e o acompanhante). Para as crianças menores de 12 anos, será solicitado o teste negativo de Covid-19 do tipo PCR, realizado até 48 horas antes do ingresso no estabelecimento, ou do tipo antígeno, realizado até 24 horas antes do acesso ao local. **REGISTRATION** The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements: 1. Take all precautions regarding COVID-19 and follow what will be indicated by the delegate and the organizer; 2. Being familiar with the WCA rules, since this is an official competition; 3. Carefully choosing the events. Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind. 1. Register through the WCA website.The registration fee is R$30,00 (registration+shirt) and must be paid on the days of competition during the registration. 5. For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (welbertmoutta@hotmail.com), or the delegate via email (gsantos@worldcubeassociation.org). Access to the venue will be allowed upon proof of the complete vaccination schedule, or a dose of vaccine and negative test for Covid-19 of the PCR type, took up to 48 hours before entering the venue, or of the antigen type, took up to 24 hours before entry into the establishment (for both competitor and companion). For children under 12 years of age, a negative Covid-19 PCR test will be required, took within 48 hours before entering the establishment, or an antigen test took within 24 hours before entering the venue.

items.name: Happy Valley Spring 2022

venue.name: [Pasquerilla Spiritual Center](https://studentaffairs.psu.edu/spiritual)
venue.address: 111 Paquerilla Spiritual Center/Eisenhower Chapel University Park, PA 16802

items.information: ## Competitors may bring at most one guest. This will be checked at the entrance of the competition. No external spectators are allowed, only those coming with a confirmed competitor will be allowed in the venue. ## In accordance with University policy all competitors 17 years of age and younger MUST have their legal guardian accompanying them to this competition. All attendees (competitors + guests) **must** show valid proof that they tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition to be allowed inside the venue. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Tuesday, March 22nd is insufficient for entrance to the competition. * Competitors may bring at most one guest. No external spectators are allowed, only those coming with a confirmed competitor will be allowed in the venue. * Masks are are required at all times and will be provided for all attendees along with hand sanitizer and sanitizing wipes. * Attendees should maintain a minimum of 3ft from others whenever possible. * The organizing team strongly recommends receiving a COVID-19 vaccination before competing. For information on, and finding vaccines near you, please use [this website](https://www.vaccines.gov/)! * If you have symptoms related to COVID-19 such as cough, fever, shortness of breath, etc. do not attend this competition. * If you have had a positive COVID-19 test or prolonged exposure to someone with the virus within 14 days prior to the competition, do not attend. * Competitors are strongly encouraged to bring their own pen for the duration of the competition. * The competition may be cancelled if the COVID-19 situation in Pennsylvania and/or the US gets worse. * By registering for this competition, you agree that you understand all the information presented in this tab, will abide by all the COVID-19 restrictions placed on this competition, and acknowledge the risk of contracting COVID-19 or any other disease in attending an event of this scale.
